title: Durga Puja outfit ideas for men
description: Durga Puja outfits for men: panjabi and dhoti, modern options, pandal-hopping tips, three budgets with real brands and prices.
intro: Durga Puja is five days of pandal hopping, adda, and food. The classic men's outfit is a panjabi, which is a kurta, with a dhoti or pyjama. The modern outfit is a plain kurta with jeans and sandals. You will walk a lot. You will sit on floors. You will take photos on Ashtami morning. Choose cotton and wear comfortable shoes. This guide shows both options and what to buy at three budgets.

sections.heading: Panjabi and dhoti, or modern
sections.body: Traditional is a cotton or silk panjabi with a dhoti or pyjama. Cream, white, and off-white with a coloured border are classic. Deep blue, maroon, and mustard work too. Modern is a short cotton kurta with dark jeans or chinos. Both look right at a pandal. For Ashtami anjali, choose the traditional option. For evening pandal hopping, choose the modern one.
tips: Traditional: cotton or tussar panjabi, dhoti or pyjama, kolhapuri or leather sandals.
Modern: short kurta, dark jeans, flat sandals.
Ashtami morning: white or cream panjabi with a red or gold border.

sections.heading: Climate note
sections.body: Durga Puja falls in September or October. Kolkata is humid and the rain can arrive without warning. Choose cotton or a light cotton silk. Avoid heavy fabric. Wear sandals or shoes you can wash. Carry a small umbrella. A white kurta shows rain and mud, so keep a spare.

sections.heading: Three looks by budget
sections.body: Prices are approximate. Fabindia, Manyavar, and Kolkata local shops all sell good panjabis. Myntra and Ajio carry the big brands.

looks.name: Pandal hopping, tight budget
pieces: Fabindia or Souled Store cotton kurta, about ₹1,200
looks.budget_inr: under 1,500 for the kurta and pyjama
looks.why: Plain cotton wins in humid weather. Keep it clean and ironed.

looks.name: Ashtami and Sunday, mid range
pieces: Fabindia tussar or cotton silk panjabi, about ₹3,000
looks.budget_inr: 1,500 to 4,000 for the panjabi and dhoti each
looks.why: A good panjabi with a clean border works for anjali and family photos.

looks.name: Evening and party, upper range
pieces: Manyavar or Rare Rabbit kurta, about ₹4,500
looks.budget_inr: 4,000 to 10,000 for the kurta and jacket
looks.why: A jacket over a plain panjabi looks sharp at Dashami evenings and the next wedding.

tips: Buy one white panjabi and two coloured ones. Rotate them over five days.
Wear sandals you can walk in all day.

sections.heading: Pandal hopping, practically
sections.body: Wear shoes you can slip on and off. Many pandals ask you to remove them. Keep your phone in a front pocket. Carry water. Start early to avoid long queues. Evening queues are very long. Keep your kurta light so you stay cool.

sections.heading: How to wear a panjabi well
sections.body: Length matters most. A traditional panjabi falls to the knee. A modern one ends at mid-thigh. If you are under 5 feet 8 inches, choose the shorter one, because a long panjabi makes you look shorter. Wear a plain vest under it. Keep the top button open and the cuffs unrolled for a clean look. If you wear a dhoti, practise the tuck at home, and keep a safety pin in your pocket. Dhunuchi dancing, long queues, and crowds all test a loose dhoti. If you are unsure, wear a pyjama and keep the dhoti for Ashtami morning. Your shoes matter more than you think. Wear flat sandals in good condition, and clean them the night before. Walking ten kilometres in the wrong shoes spoils the whole day.

sections.heading: What to stop buying
sections.body: Stop buying heavy silk panjabis for pandal hopping. Stop buying white-on-white that you cannot sit in. Stop buying pointed leather shoes for rain and crowds. Buy two cotton panjabis and one good pair of sandals.

sections.heading: Grooming in one line
sections.body: Trim your beard, oil your hair lightly against humidity, and use deodorant, not heavy perfume.

faq.q: What should men wear for Durga Puja?
faq.a: A panjabi with a dhoti or pyjama is classic. A short cotton kurta with jeans is the modern option. Choose cotton for humid weather.

faq.q: What colour should men wear on Ashtami?
faq.a: White or cream with a red or gold border is traditional. Many men also wear deep blue or maroon.

faq.q: Can I wear jeans with a panjabi?
faq.a: Yes. Use a short panjabi with dark jeans. Avoid a very long panjabi with jeans.

faq.q: What shoes are best for pandal hopping?
faq.a: Sandals or kolhapuris. You will walk a lot and may remove them at some pandals.

faq.q: How many outfits do I need for the five days?
faq.a: Three is enough. Wear a cream panjabi for Ashtami morning, a coloured cotton kurta for daytime pandal hopping, and a kurta with a jacket for the evening. Rotate them and add a new stole or sandals if you want variety. Nobody tracks repeats in a crowd.
